meta.description: Portfolio of Rayane Van Osselt (RVO), UX/UI web designer and web developer in Belgium: custom websites, interfaces and polished visuals.

hero.lead: I design and build custom websites and interfaces, from UX thinking all the way to launch. One point of contact, for a result that stays consistent down to the smallest detail.

about.label: About
about.titleHtml:
One point of contact,
from idea to screen.
about.lead: I’m Rayane Van Osselt. I design web experiences end to end: I shape the user journeys, design the interfaces, then build them myself. What you approve in the mockup is exactly what goes live.
about.body: To me, a good website is felt before it is read: clear, fast and consistent down to the details. That’s what drives every decision I make, from the first wireframe to the last line of code.
about.visual: My eye also comes from imagery. Photo editing, video, illustration, layout: I take care of the visuals that bring an interface to life.

services.title: Web design & UX/UI
services.text: User journeys, wireframes, mockups and prototypes in Figma, designed to be understood in seconds.

services.title: Web development
services.text: Custom, responsive and multilingual websites, or a tailored WordPress build when the project calls for it.

services.title: Visual content
services.text: Photo editing, video, vector graphics and layout, for an identity that holds together on every medium.

work.label: Selected work
work.intro: Launched websites, app mockups, an interactive game and editorial layout: a selection that shows how I work, from concept to detail.
work.designIntro: Figma mockups, team projects, an interactive game and print layout: the other side of my work.

rufix.title: Rufix Barber
rufix.summary: The website of a barber who works by appointment only. A warm, low-lit atmosphere true to the salon, a three-step booking request and a fully trilingual experience.
rufix.alt: Rufix Barber homepage, headlined “L’art de la coupe masculine”

wisy.title: Wisy Safety
wisy.summary: The website of an occupational safety training centre (VCA, EPB, first aid) based in Anderlecht, Brussels. Custom-designed sections showcase its accreditation, partners and premises.
wisy.alt: Wisy Safety homepage, headlined “La sécurité, comme une référence”

cafe.title: Café Clavier Causeries
cafe.summary: A collaborative project built as a team: an illustrated identity around a coffee-cup mascot, a presentation of each member’s role and a shared pitch, all designed in Figma.
cafe.alt: Café Clavier Causeries logo: a smiling, hand-drawn coffee cup

camera.title: Caméra Quartier
camera.summary: A complete multi-page website mockup: structure, content and navigation designed in Figma around a bright, sunny identity.
camera.alt: Caméra Quartier logo: a camera at the centre of an illustrated city

prompt.title: Génération Prompt
prompt.summary: The interface of an app dedicated to generating AI prompts: screens, user flows and reusable components, designed in Figma.
prompt.alt: Génération Prompt logo: a gradient “ai” speech bubble

labyrinthe.title: Labyrinthe des souvenirs
labyrinthe.summary: An adventure game made by a team of three in Genially: a character to guide to the very end, hints and mini-challenges (connect, drag, black out words), playable on computer, tablet and phone.
labyrinthe.alt: Labyrinthe des souvenirs logo: a stylised square maze

indesign.title: InDesign work
indesign.summary: “L’Orée des Sens”, an 18-page brochure for a spa set in the heart of nature: grid, typography and editorial rhythm crafted in InDesign.

skills.label: Skills
skills.intro: Web development and UX/UI are at the core of what I do. Around them sit creative tools I practise seriously, so I can deliver complete projects, from code to imagery.
skills.hint: Pick a skill to see what I do with it.

web.name: Web development
web.description: Fast, responsive and accessible websites with clean, maintainable code: hand-written HTML, CSS and JavaScript, third-party integrations, and WordPress when the project calls for it.

uxui.name: UX/UI design
uxui.tagline: The other half of my work.
uxui.description: Clear journeys, sharp visual hierarchy, consistent interfaces: I design experiences that guide users effortlessly and make them want to explore further.

lightroom.name: Lightroom
lightroom.description: Retouching, colour grading and consistent series: I prepare photos that are ready to elevate a website, a portfolio or a campaign.

figma.name: Figma
figma.description: Wireframes, mockups, components and prototypes: Figma is where I design and present my interfaces before building them.

illustrator.name: Illustrator
illustrator.description: Logos, icons and graphic elements: I create crisp vector visuals, ready for screen and print.

premiere.name: Premiere Pro
premiere.description: Cutting, pacing and simple titling: I produce polished videos for the web and social media.

method.label: Approach
method.titleHtml:
A clear process,
a polished result.
method.intro: Every project follows the same steps, so we move forward without surprises and approve each decision at the right time.

steps.title: Understand
steps.text: We talk through your goals, your audience and your content. I clarify what the website needs to achieve before designing anything.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Site map, wireframes, then Figma mockups: you approve the design and user flows before the first line of code.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: I turn the mockup into clean code: responsive, accessible, fast, and multilingual if your audience needs it.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: Testing on mobile, tablet and desktop, optimisation, then launch. And we fine-tune together if needed.

contact.label: Contact
contact.intro: A website to build, an interface to rethink or visuals to refine? Write to me: I’ll reply personally, with a clear and concrete answer.
